citations.assessment: The cached digital text names Chananyah son of Yasa at 1:5:2. A further digital witness has a variant initial letter, to retain if directly collated.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The prior Chinena entry has the direct explicit reciprocal note “at the end of Maaserot, Chananyah bar Yasa”. This gives the internal comparison without making the two names identical elsewhere.

notes.text: Both the exact Maaserot passage and the reciprocal Chinena entry give the Yasa relationship here.
